arabic text: HAL MIN NAASAREEN YAN SUR NAA\nAMMA HAYE AMMA
english translation text: IS THERE ANYONE TO HELP ME?\nMOTHER O’ MOTHER

arabic text: SINE SE AB LAGALO AGHOSH ME CHUUPALO AMMA MUJHE SAMBHAALO
english translation text: HOLD ME TO YOUR CHEST, HIDE ME IN YOUR BOSOM, MOTHER SUPPORT ME

arabic text: NAZDEEK AA RAHA HU, WADA NIBHARAHA HU, AMMA MUJHE SAMBHALO
english translation text: I AM COMING CLOSE, I AM FULFILLING MY PROMISE, MOTHER SUPPORT ME

arabic text: AKBAR NAHI HAI GHAZI, DARYA PE SOGAYA HAI\nRAAH-E-KHUDA MAY SARA, KUNBA UJJAR GAYA HAI\nBE AAS HOGAYA HU(N)
english translation text: AKBAR IS NO LONGER HERE, MY WARRIOR SLEEPS ON THE RIVER BANK\nIN THE PATH OF GOD, MY ENTIRE FAMILY HAS BEEN DESTROYED\nI AM WITHOUT ANY SUPPORT

arabic text: TANHA MAY REHGAYA HU(N)\nAMMA MUJHE SAMBHAALO
english translation text: I AM LEFT ALL ALONE\nMOTHER SUPPORT ME

arabic text: AWAAZ DASHT MAY JAB, HAL MIN KI DE RAHA THA\nABBAS-E-BAWAFA KA, LASHA TARAP RAHA THA
english translation text: MY LOYAL ABBAS’S BODY TREMBLED\nWHEN I RAISED MY VOICE IN THE DESERT CALLING 'HAL MIN'

arabic text: MAQTAL MAY AA RAHA HU(N)\nTUMKO BULA RAHA HU(N)\nAMMA MUJHE SAMBHAALO
english translation text: I AM COMING TO THE BATTLEFIELD\nCALLING OUT TO YOU\nMOTHER SUPPORT ME

arabic text: DUBA HUWA LAHU MAY, YE DASHT-E-KARBALA HAI\nCHEHRE PE KHOON-E-ASGHAR, MENE YUHI(N) MALA HAI
english translation text: THIS LAND OF KARBALA, IS DRENCHED IN BLOOD\nI HAVE COVERED MY FACE WITH ASGHAR’S BLOOD

arabic text: KIS HAAL MEI HAI AMMA\nPYAASA YE LAAL TERA\nAMMA MUJHE SAMBHAALO
english translation text: WHAT IS THE STATE O MOTHER\nOF THIS THIRSTY SON OF YOURS\nMOTHER SUPPORT ME

arabic text: ZAKHMO(N) SE MERA AMMA, TAN CHUR HOGAYA HAI\nLASHE UTHA UTHA KE, DIL GHAM SE BHAR GAYA HAI
english translation text: O MOTHER, MY BODY IS CRUSHED BY THE WOUNDS\nCARRYING THE BODIES HAS FILLED MY HEART WITH SORROW

arabic text: CHARO(N) TARAF HAI HAMLAA\nTALWAR KI TABAR KA\nAMMA MUJHE SAMBHALO
english translation text: THE ATTACK IS FROM ALL FOUR CORNERS\nOF SWORDS AND AXES\nMOTHER SUPPORT ME

arabic text: AANKHO(N) KE SAAMNE HAY, HAR BACHPANE KA MANZAR\nLORI SUNA RAHAY THE, ZANU(N) PE TUM SULAAKAR
english translation text: BEFORE MY EYES ARE VISIONS OF MY CHILDHOOD\nYOU, PUTTING ME TO SLEEP ON YOUR LAP, SINGING A LULLABY

arabic text: AB HAAL AAKE DEKHO\nGODI MAY MUJHKO LELO\nAMMA MUJHE SAMBHALO
english translation text: COME AND SEE MY STATE NOW\nTAKE ME IN YOUR LAP\nMOTHER SUPPORT ME

arabic text: LUT JAYENGI RIDAAEY(N), KHAYME BHI AB JALENGE\nPYAARI MERI SAKINA, KE BALIYAA(N) CHINENGE
english translation text: THE CLOAKS WILL BE LOOTED, TENTS WILL BE BURNED\nMY BELOVED SAKINA’S EARRINGS WILL BE SNATCHED

arabic text: SHAAM-E-GHARIBAA(N) MEI TAB\nHOGI SADA-E-ZAINAB\nAMMA MUJHE SAMBHAALO
english translation text: IN SHAM-E-GHARIBA THEN\nZAINAB’S CALL WILL BE\nMOTHER SUPPORT ME

arabic text: AMMA BADAN YE SARA, TEERO(N) SE AB BHARA HAI\nGHORE PE NA ZAMEE(N) PAR, LASHA MERA PARA HAI
english translation text: O MOTHER THIS BODY IS PIERCED FULL OF ARROWS\nMY BODY IS LAYING NEITHER ON THE HORSE NOR THE GROUND

arabic text: AB SHIMR KI CHURI HAY\nGARDAN PE CHAL RAHI HAY\nAMMA MUJHE SAMBHAALO
english translation text: NOW IT’S SHIMR’S DAGGER\nCUTTING MY THROAT\nMOTHER SUPPORT ME

arabic text: SAJDE MEI MERA SAR HAI, TALWAAR CHAL RAHI HAY\nKHAYME KE DAR PE ZAINAB, BECHAIN HO RAHI HAY
english translation text: THE SWORD IS CUTTING MY HEAD, I AM IN SAJDA,\nZAINAB IS RESTLESS ON THE DOOR OF THE TENT

arabic text: TUTTEGI AB QAYAMAT\nNAZDEEK HAY SHAHADAT\nAMMA MUJHE SAMBHAALO
english translation text: QIYAMAT WILL ARRIVE NOW\nMARTYRDOM IS CLOSE\nMOTHER SUPPORT ME

arabic text: KAISE LIKHE 'TEJANI', PURDARD KA WO MANZAR\nJAB SHIMR NE CHALAYA, IBNE ALI PE KHANJAR
english translation text: HOW WILL TEJANI SCRIPT, THAT PAIN FILLED SCENE\nWHEN SHIMR STABBED(CONTINUOUSLY) SON OF ALI WITH THE SWORD

arabic text: AWAAZ THI FIZA MAY,\nHAAYE DASHT-E-KARBALA MAY\nAMMA MUJHE SAMBHALO
english translation text: A VOICE ROSE IN THE SKY\nIN THE DESERT OF KARBALA\nMOTHER SUPPORT ME

arabic text: AMMA MUJHE SAMBHALO
english translation text: MOTHER SUPPORT ME
